title: Warm reviewer continuity across pool updates
description: An isolated native provider and authenticated gateway reads prove that static re-reviews retain their conversation across an unrelated pool change and a lost handoff resume reply. Explicit effort changes still use the delta-scoped cold fallback. No product run or slot is touched.

warm-continuity.intent: Retain the native conversation and admit one round while reconciling a lost resume reply; preserve explicit cold fallback behavior.
